findings.finding: All three candidates passed the deterministic evaluator. Candidate files were byte-identical between runtime variants and across Ubuntu 22.04 and Ubuntu 24.04 Arm images.
findings.decision: retain as the only supported model and quantization condition for the next synthetic Setup Companion experiment

findings.finding: All three candidate files contained invalid or nonsensical text and no valid JSON object.

Two of three candidates passed deterministic structure. The STOP fixture nevertheless contradicted its own action by saying it was not necessary to leave the device untouched; the reboot fixture omitted required verifier-restoration reasoning.
findings.decision: reject pending a separately investigated toolchain-output stability question

findings.finding: Only zero or one of three fixtures passed per condition. Outputs were malformed, incomplete or insufficiently grounded despite large speed and memory gains.
findings.decision: reject; efficiency does not cross the quality boundary

boundary: This audit is not blinded or independent and does not establish real-device safety. It records obvious semantic contradictions that the deterministic verifier cannot fully judge.
